```plato
//==
// # Rotations and orientations
//
// Multiple interchangeable representations of rotation
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Rotation_(mathematics)). Quaternion is
// canonical for 3D composition and interpolation; the others serve authoring,
// interop, and geometric-algebra styles.
// Discoverability: the concrete operations for Quaternion
// (and the rotor/motor conversions) are declared on the intrinsic hub in
// `intrinsics.library.plato` and in the `transforms-*.library.plato`
// files, not restated here. Bivector3D is
// the geometric-algebra dual of a Vector3D cross product (components YZ, ZX, XY
// <-> X, Y, Z under the right-hand convention); construct one from a vector pair
// with `Wedge` in `numeric-structures.library.plato`.

// A unit quaternion encoding a 3D rotation
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Quaternion). Invariant: X*X + Y*Y + Z*Z + W*W = 1.
type Quaternion
    implements IValue, IMultiplicative, IInterpolatable, IRigid3D
{
    X: Number;
    Y: Number;
    Z: Number;
    W: Number;
}
```
